fireball.name: Mage Spell Cast 3
fireball.why: fastest release of the three throws (5.35 m/s against 4.43 and 3.30), and the leading hand is her LEFT -- the free hand, since the staff is in her right. 126 and 136 throw with the right, which would swing the staff.

meteor.name: Charged Ground Slam
meteor.why: a raise to 0.355 m above the head then a DROP at 8.48 m/s, nearly three times either alternative (2.86, 3.28). The hand is her RIGHT -- the staff hand -- so she lifts the staff to the sky and drives it down: the call-down, literally.

release_s_definition.fireball: the instant of the leading hand's peak FORWARD speed -- a throw is defined by its release speed
release_s_definition.meteor: the instant of peak DOWNWARD speed after the hand's highest point -- a raise alone is a salute, a drop alone a slap
